idea-plugin.name: RequestHandoff
idea-plugin.description:
RequestHandoff exports JetBrains HTTP Client files (.http, .rest) and folders of them to Postman Collection v2.1, and exports http-client.env.json environments to Postman environment files.

Folder export and environment export are free. Request files are parsed directly, with no dependency on the HTTP Client plugin, so this works in every JetBrains IDE, including Community editions.

Postman is a trademark of Postman, Inc. JetBrains and IntelliJ are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o. This project is not affiliated with either.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0 — Export .http and .rest files and folders, plus public HTTP Client environments. Private environment values stay opt-in.
